exam_name: Institute of National Importance Combined Entrance Test (INI-CET)
fact: Creation of INI-CET: Established in November 2020 by the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, INI-CET replaced four separate premier medical examinations—AIIMS PG, JIPMER PG, PGIMER Chandigarh, and NIMHANS entrance—into a single combined test to eliminate severe exam travel fatigue for medical doctors.

exam_name: Institute of National Importance Combined Entrance Test (INI-CET)
fact: Institutional Scope Across 26 Apex Centers: INI-CET governs postgraduate admissions across India's most prestigious medical centers of national importance, encompassing AIIMS New Delhi, 21 newer operational AIIMS across India, PGIMER Chandigarh, JIPMER Puducherry, NIMHANS Bengaluru, and SCTIMST Thiruvananthapuram.

exam_name: Institute of National Importance Combined Entrance Test (INI-CET)
fact: The PAAR Architecture: AIIMS pioneered the Prospective Applicants Advanced Registration (PAAR) system, which stores candidates' verified photos, signatures, and demographic data permanently in a central database, requiring candidates to simply generate an Examination Unique Code (EUC) for future cycles without repeating document uploads.

exam_name: Institute of National Importance Super-Specialty Entrance Test (INI-SS)
fact: Two-Tier Evaluation System: INI-SS features a distinct two-stage structure where Stage I is an 80-mark computer-based objective examination used across all participating INIs, followed by Stage II, an intensive 20-mark institutional departmental assessment conducted exclusively for admission to AIIMS institutes.

exam_name: Institute of National Importance Super-Specialty Entrance Test (INI-SS)
fact: Pinnacle of Clinical Medicine: Catering exclusively to qualified MD, MS, and DNB degree holders, INI-SS is India's most academically demanding clinical entrance examination, offering entry to sub-specialist doctorates (DM and M.Ch) in complex specializations like Cardiothoracic Surgery, Neuro-intervention, and Pediatric Oncology.

exam_name: Institute of National Importance Super-Specialty Entrance Test (INI-SS)
fact: Unification of Super-Specialty Admissions: Prior to 2021, DM and M.Ch aspirants had to travel to sit for separate entrance exams conducted by AIIMS, PGIMER, and JIPMER within days of each other; INI-SS successfully unified these into a synchronized single examination window.

exam_name: AIIMS B.Sc Nursing Entrance Examination [B.Sc. (Hons.) Nursing / B.Sc. Nursing (Post-Basic)]
fact: Female-Only Tradition for B.Sc (Hons.): The flagship 4-year B.Sc. (Hons.) Nursing program across all AIIMS institutes in India is strictly reserved exclusively for female candidates, maintaining a historic legacy in national nursing leadership, whereas the B.Sc. Nursing Post-Basic program is co-educational.

exam_name: AIIMS B.Sc Nursing Entrance Examination [B.Sc. (Hons.) Nursing / B.Sc. Nursing (Post-Basic)]
fact: Historic College of Nursing Legacy: The College of Nursing at AIIMS New Delhi traces its founding back to 1946 (established as the College of Nursing under the Ministry of Health) prior to being incorporated under the historic AIIMS Act of 1956, making it one of the oldest collegiate nursing institutions in South Asia.

exam_name: AIIMS B.Sc Nursing Entrance Examination [B.Sc. (Hons.) Nursing / B.Sc. Nursing (Post-Basic)]
fact: Advance Scrutiny Mechanism: AIIMS Nursing was one of the earliest undergraduate entrances to implement advance digital document scrutiny months before test center allotment, virtually eliminating admit-card photo defects and exam-day entry disputes.

exam_name: Joint Admission test for Masters (IIT JAM)
fact: Gateway Beyond IITs: While organized and hosted by rotating IITs, IIT JAM scores are also officially utilized for admissions to Integrated Ph.D. programs at the Indian Institute of Science (IISc Bengaluru) and for M.Sc. admissions to over 30 National Institutes of Technology (NITs) via the Centralized Counselling for M.Sc. (CCMN).

exam_name: Joint Admission test for Masters (IIT JAM)
fact: Annual Organising Rotation: JAM administration rotates annually among the first-generation IITs (IIT Delhi in 2025, IIT Madras in 2024, IIT Guwahati in 2023, IIT Roorkee in 2022), with the chosen host institute building the test papers and overseeing JOAPS operations nationwide.

exam_name: Joint Admission test for Masters (IIT JAM)
fact: Multidisciplinary Two-Paper Flexibility: Candidates appearing for JAM can write up to two test papers across seven scientific disciplines (Biotechnology, Chemistry, Economics, Geology, Mathematics, Mathematical Statistics, Physics) in separate morning and afternoon sessions, enabling science graduates to transition into quantitative economics and data analytics.

exam_name: Common Entrance Examination for Design (CEED)
fact: Hand-Drawn Sketching in a Digital Age: While Part-A of CEED is a computer-based screening test, Part-B is an offline pen-and-paper drawing and sketching examination conducted in the same 3-hour session, where candidates must manually illustrate perspective views, user interactions, and product redesigns using pencils and rendering colours.

exam_name: Common Entrance Examination for Design (CEED)
fact: IDC School of Design Heritage: CEED was created by IIT Bombay’s Industrial Design Centre (IDC), founded in 1969 with UNESCO assistance, which designed India's iconic national symbols, including the Indian Rupee symbol (₹) created by IDC alumnus Dr. Udaya Kumar Dharmalingam.

exam_name: Common Entrance Examination for Design (CEED)
fact: Zero Weightage of Part-A in Final Rank: In a rare examination architecture, Part-A marks serve strictly as a cut-off qualification filter; the final CEED merit rank for qualified candidates is determined 100% solely by their performance in the hand-evaluated Part-B sketching test!

exam_name: Undergraduate Common Entrance Examination for Design (UCEED)
fact: First Undergraduate Design Degree at IITs: Launched in 2015 by IIT Bombay, UCEED made history by opening the doors of the Indian Institutes of Technology to undergraduate students from Arts, Humanities, and Commerce backgrounds, breaking the traditional engineering-only focus of the IIT system.

exam_name: Undergraduate Common Entrance Examination for Design (UCEED)
fact: Two Maximum Consecutive Attempts Rule: While UCEED is open to candidates of any stream, it enforces a strict lifetime cap of at most two attempts in consecutive years, mirroring the high selectivity of JEE Advanced.

exam_name: Undergraduate Common Entrance Examination for Design (UCEED)
fact: Rapid Expansion Across Tech Campuses: Originally offering B.Des only at IIT Bombay, UCEED admission scores are now directly accepted by IIT Delhi, IIT Guwahati, IIT Hyderabad, and IIITDM Jabalpur, and shared with over 30 leading private and state design universities across India.

exam_name: National Institute of Fashion Technology Entrance Examination (NIFT Admissions)
fact: Established with FIT New York: Founded in 1986 in New Delhi under the Ministry of Textiles, NIFT was established in technical collaboration with the Fashion Institute of Technology (FIT), New York, and statutory autonomy was granted by the Indian Parliament via the NIFT Act of 2006.

exam_name: National Institute of Fashion Technology Entrance Examination (NIFT Admissions)
fact: Elite Alumni Lineage: NIFT has educated India's most celebrated global fashion couturiers and creative directors, including Sabyasachi Mukherjee, Manish Arora, Ritu Beri, and Rajesh Pratap Singh.

exam_name: National Institute of Fashion Technology Entrance Examination (NIFT Admissions)
fact: The Hands-on Situation Test: Beyond written objective and sketching tests (GAT and CAT), shortlisted candidates must sit for a practical 'Situation Test' where they are provided a mystery packet of everyday craft materials (thermocol, wire, clay, cardboard) to construct a 3D model within two hours.

exam_name: National Institute of Design Design Aptitude Test (NID DAT)
fact: Rooted in The India Report by Charles and Ray Eames: NID was founded in 1961 as a direct consequence of the famous 1958 'The India Report' authored by legendary American designers Charles and Ray Eames at the request of the Government of India, proposing a design institute rooted in Indian culture and rapid industrial development.

exam_name: National Institute of Design Design Aptitude Test (NID DAT)
fact: Two-Tier DAT Filtering with Studio Tests: NID DAT is famed for its hands-on DAT Mains Studio Test, where shortlisted candidates manipulate physical materials (clay, wire, plaster) to build tactile prototypes, accompanied by audio-visual perception tests and personal interviews.

exam_name: National Institute of Design Design Aptitude Test (NID DAT)
fact: Statutory Institute of National Importance: In 2014, Parliament enacted the National Institute of Design Act declaring NID Ahmedabad an Institute of National Importance, which was subsequently expanded in 2019 to incorporate NIDs in Andhra Pradesh, Haryana, Madhya Pradesh, and Assam.

exam_name: Common Management Admission Test (CMAT)
fact: AICTE to NTA Transition: CMAT was introduced in 2012 by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE) as a single nationwide testing gateway for all AICTE-approved management institutions, until testing responsibilities were transferred to the National Testing Agency (NTA) in 2019.

exam_name: Common Management Admission Test (CMAT)
fact: Pioneering Innovation and Entrepreneurship Section: In 2021, CMAT became the first premier national MBA entrance examination to introduce an optional (now mandatory) 20-question section evaluating startups, design thinking, and business innovation principles alongside quantitative and verbal ability.

exam_name: Common Management Admission Test (CMAT)
fact: Massive Institutional Network: CMAT scores are accepted by over 1,300 AICTE-approved business schools and universities across India, representing one of the largest umbrella admissions networks for management education in Asia.

exam_name: Joint Integrated Programme in Management Admission Test (JIPMAT)
fact: High-School-to-IIM Direct Highway: JIPMAT offers Class 12 high school students a direct pipeline to earn an integrated BBA+MBA degree from two prestigious Indian Institutes of Management (IIM Bodh Gaya and IIM Jammu) without ever having to write the post-graduate CAT exam.

exam_name: Joint Integrated Programme in Management Admission Test (JIPMAT)
fact: Flexible Dual-Exit Provision: Students admitted through JIPMAT have the option to exit the 5-year IPM program after successfully finishing three years with a Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) degree, or continue into the 2-year MBA curriculum seamlessly.

exam_name: Joint Integrated Programme in Management Admission Test (JIPMAT)
fact: Historic Inter-IIM Collaborative Testing: JIPMAT represents an unprecedented collaborative admissions pact where two distinct IIMs unified their entrance requirements into a single joint national examination conducted by NTA, halving candidate form fees and eliminating scheduling conflicts.

exam_name: National Council for Hotel Management Joint Entrance Examination (NCHM JEE)
fact: Apex Hospitality Council Legacy: Established in 1982 by the Ministry of Tourism, the National Council for Hotel Management and Catering Technology (NCHMCT) pioneered hospitality standards across India, establishing the country's premier network of Institutes of Hotel Management (IHMs).

exam_name: National Council for Hotel Management Joint Entrance Examination (NCHM JEE)
fact: Academic Partnership with JNU: Beginning from the 2023 academic session, the degrees for the 3-year B.Sc. in Hospitality and Hotel Administration across Central Institutes of Hotel Management are officially awarded by Jawaharlal Nehru University (JNU), New Delhi.

exam_name: National Council for Hotel Management Joint Entrance Examination (NCHM JEE)
fact: Global Hospitality Leaders Alum: The Central IHMs (such as IHM Pusa New Delhi and IHM Mumbai) have produced India's most celebrated masterchefs and hospitality titans, including Chef Sanjeev Kapoor and Chef Ranveer Brar.

exam_name: National Common Entrance Test (NCET) for 4-Year Integrated Teacher Education Programme (ITEP)
fact: Flagship NEP 2020 Teacher Education Reform: Launched under the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020 by the National Council for Teacher Education (NCTE), NCET represents India's transition towards dual-major 4-year undergraduate B.Ed degrees (B.A. B.Ed, B.Sc. B.Ed, B.Com. B.Ed), phasing out legacy stand-alone B.Ed colleges.

exam_name: National Common Entrance Test (NCET) for 4-Year Integrated Teacher Education Programme (ITEP)
fact: Engineering Institutes Teaching Pedagogy: In a historic first for Indian technical education, premier institutions like IIT Kharagpur and several National Institutes of Technology (NITs) now admit school-leavers into professional teacher training degrees through NCET.

exam_name: National Common Entrance Test (NCET) for 4-Year Integrated Teacher Education Programme (ITEP)
fact: 13-Language Nationwide Testing: NCET is administered simultaneously across 13 Indian regional languages (Assamese, Bengali, English, Gujarati, Hindi, Kannada, Malayalam, Marathi, Odia, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu, and Urdu) to ensure equitable national access for rural educators.

exam_name: National Initiative for Technical Teachers Training (NITTT) Examination [Part 1 and Part 2]
fact: Mandatory Faculty Induction Prerequisite: Instituted by AICTE and the Ministry of Education, NITTT certification across 8 structured pedagogy modules is a statutory prerequisite for fresh assistant professors across all AICTE-approved engineering and polytechnic colleges to complete their employment probation.

exam_name: National Initiative for Technical Teachers Training (NITTT) Examination [Part 1 and Part 2]
fact: Crafted by the Four Apex NITTTRs: The technical pedagogy curriculum was designed through a consortium of India’s four National Institutes of Technical Teachers Training and Research (NITTTR Bhopal, Chandigarh, Chennai, and Kolkata) to modernize laboratory teaching and outcome-based education.

exam_name: National Initiative for Technical Teachers Training (NITTT) Examination [Part 1 and Part 2]
fact: SWAYAM-MOOCs to Proctored CBT Pipeline: The examination combines self-paced learning on the Government of India's SWAYAM portal with rigorous, proctored national computer-based examinations administered by NTA twice annually.

exam_name: Scheme for Residential Education for Students in High Classes in Targeted Areas (SHRESHTA - NETS)
fact: 100% Fully Funded Private Boarding Schooling: SHRESHTA bears the entire financial cost—covering school admission fees, residential boarding, hostel charges, textbooks, and food—for meritorious Scheduled Caste (SC) boys and girls to study in top private residential CBSE schools across India.

exam_name: Scheme for Residential Education for Students in High Classes in Targeted Areas (SHRESHTA - NETS)
fact: Completely Free National Examination: Unlike standard entrance tests which charge processing fees, NTA collects zero examination fee (₹0) from any candidate appearing for SHRESHTA-NETS.

exam_name: Scheme for Residential Education for Students in High Classes in Targeted Areas (SHRESHTA - NETS)
fact: 3,000 Annual High-School Scholars: Annually distributes approximately 3,000 fully funded scholarship seats directly into Class 9 and Class 11 in accredited CBSE residential campuses nationwide to build future leaders from disadvantaged backgrounds.

exam_name: ICAR All India Entrance Examination for Admission to Bachelor Degree Programmes via CUET (UG) [CUET (ICAR-UG)]
fact: Sunset of 27-Year-Old AIEEA-UG: In 2023, the Indian Council of Agricultural Research retired its historic standalone national entrance examination (ICAR AIEEA-UG, launched in 1996) and integrated all undergraduate agricultural admissions into the unified CUET-UG framework.

exam_name: ICAR All India Entrance Examination for Admission to Bachelor Degree Programmes via CUET (UG) [CUET (ICAR-UG)]
fact: National Talent Scholarship (NTS) Entitlement: Candidates admitted under the 15-20% ICAR all-India quota who enroll in an agricultural university outside their home state are awarded the ICAR National Talent Scholarship (NTS) of ₹3,000 per month throughout their 4-year degree.

exam_name: ICAR All India Entrance Examination for Admission to Bachelor Degree Programmes via CUET (UG) [CUET (ICAR-UG)]
fact: Pan-India Agri-University Umbrella: Fills all-India seats across 70+ Agricultural, Horticultural, Veterinary, and Fishery Universities, including premier national institutions like NDRI Karnal and IARI New Delhi.

exam_name: ICAR All India Entrance Examination for Admission to Master Degree Programmes (ICAR AIEEA PG)
fact: Generous ICAR-PG Scholarships: High-ranking candidates across 20 Major Subject Groups are awarded the prestigious ICAR-PG Scholarship of ₹12,640 per month for two years plus annual contingency allowances.

exam_name: ICAR All India Entrance Examination for Admission to Master Degree Programmes (ICAR AIEEA PG)
fact: NAEAB Accreditation Requirement: ICAR strictly enforces that candidates are eligible for admission only if their undergraduate degree was completed at a college and program fully accredited by the National Agricultural Education Accreditation Board (NAEAB).

exam_name: ICAR All India Entrance Examination for Admission to Master Degree Programmes (ICAR AIEEA PG)
fact: 80+ Specialized Disciplines: A single entrance test governs Master’s admissions across more than 80 agricultural science disciplines, spanning Plant Biotechnology, Nematology, Post-Harvest Technology, and Agricultural Economics.

exam_name: ICAR All India Competitive Examination for Admission to Doctoral Degree Programmes & Award of JRF/SRF (PhD) [ICAR AICE-JRF/SRF (PhD)]
fact: Apex Agricultural Research Fellowships: Awards the prestigious ICAR-JRF/SRF (PhD) fellowship of ₹31,000 per month for the first two years (JRF) and ₹35,000 per month for the third year (SRF) plus house rent allowance and annual contingency.

exam_name: ICAR All India Competitive Examination for Admission to Doctoral Degree Programmes & Award of JRF/SRF (PhD) [ICAR AICE-JRF/SRF (PhD)]
fact: Direct Admission to Green Revolution Cradle: Serves as the primary doctoral entrance for the Indian Agricultural Research Institute (IARI Pusa, New Delhi), where Norman Borlaug's semi-dwarf wheat varieties were bred and field-tested during India's Green Revolution.

exam_name: ICAR All India Competitive Examination for Admission to Doctoral Degree Programmes & Award of JRF/SRF (PhD) [ICAR AICE-JRF/SRF (PhD)]
fact: Strict Negative Marking & Subject Breadth: Features a high-stakes 120-question computer-based test with 4 marks for correct and -1 for incorrect answers across 72 sub-disciplines.

exam_name: All India AYUSH Post Graduate Entrance Test (AIAPGET)
fact: Quad-System Traditional Medicine Gateway: Single testing umbrella evaluating four traditional medical disciplines—Ayurveda, Unani, Siddha, and Homoeopathy—generating four independent all-India merit ranks in parallel.

exam_name: All India AYUSH Post Graduate Entrance Test (AIAPGET)
fact: Statutory 1-Year Clinical Internship Cut-off: Requires candidates to have completed a 12-month compulsory rotatory clinical internship post-BAMS/BUMS/BSMS/BHMS by a nationally synchronized cut-off date to participate in seat counselling.

exam_name: All India AYUSH Post Graduate Entrance Test (AIAPGET)
fact: Apex AYUSH Institutes: Fills seats at India's highest institutes of traditional medicine: All India Institute of Ayurveda (AIIA New Delhi), National Institute of Homoeopathy (NIH Kolkata), National Institute of Unani Medicine (NIUM Bengaluru), and National Institute of Siddha (NIS Chennai).

exam_name: Rashtriya Military Schools Common Entrance Test (RMS CET) for Class VI and Class IX
fact: King George's Royal Military Schools Heritage: Founded between 1925 and 1962 as King George's Royal Indian Military Colleges (the earliest at Chail founded in 1925) to provide boarding education to the children of Indian military personnel.

exam_name: Rashtriya Military Schools Common Entrance Test (RMS CET) for Class VI and Class IX
fact: Highest Military School in the World: Rashtriya Military School Chail is perched at an altitude of 7,500 feet (2,286 meters) in Himachal Pradesh's Shivalik Hills, possessing the highest school cricket ground and military campus globally.

exam_name: Rashtriya Military Schools Common Entrance Test (RMS CET) for Class VI and Class IX
fact: 70% Quota for JCOs/OR Personnel: 70% of total seats are reserved for children of Junior Commissioned Officers (JCOs) and Other Ranks (OR) of the Army, Navy, and Air Force, with 50 seats reserved for children of service personnel killed in action.

exam_name: Rashtriya Indian Military College Entrance Examination (RIMC Entrance Exam)
fact: Cradle of Indian Military Leadership: Founded on 13 March 1922 by the Prince of Wales (King Edward VIII) in Dehradun, RIMC has produced scores of Armed Forces Chiefs, including four Indian Chiefs of Army Staff, two Chiefs of Naval Staff, and four Chiefs of Air Staff.

exam_name: Rashtriya Indian Military College Entrance Examination (RIMC Entrance Exam)
fact: Historic Supreme Court Directive on Girl Cadets: In 2021, under orders from the Supreme Court of India, RIMC broke a century-old tradition and opened its entrance examination and military academy gates to girl cadets starting from the July 2022 term.

exam_name: Rashtriya Indian Military College Entrance Examination (RIMC Entrance Exam)
fact: Microscopic State-Quota Selectivity: RIMC admits only 25 to 30 cadets per term (~50 to 60 cadets per year from the entire country) into Class VIII, with vacancies allocated on a quota of just 1 to 2 cadets per State/Union Territory, making it India's most selective school entrance.

exam_name: Army Cadet College (ACC) Entrance Examination
fact: The Soldiers' Gateway to Commission: Known as the 'Cradle of Leadership', ACC is the Indian Armed Forces' historic internal feeder academy allowing serving soldiers, sailors, and airmen of Other Ranks with at least two years of service to rise and earn a permanent officer commission.

exam_name: Army Cadet College (ACC) Entrance Examination
fact: Nowgong Origin to IMA Wing: Established on 16 May 1960 at Nowgong (Madhya Pradesh) by General K.S. Thimayya, ACC was relocated in 1977 to Dehradun as the ACC Wing of the Indian Military Academy (IMA), awarding graduating cadets a 3-year bachelor's degree from JNU before their final pre-commission year.

exam_name: Army Cadet College (ACC) Entrance Examination
fact: Param Vir Chakra Lineage: Major Somnath Sharma, the recipient of India’s first Param Vir Chakra (PVC) in 1947, was an alumnus of earlier military training wings, and ACC has produced hundreds of decorated gallantry award winners including Ashok Chakra and Maha Vir Chakra recipients.

exam_name: Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya Lateral Entry Selection Test for Class IX (JNV LEST Class IX)
fact: Free Residential Co-educational System: Under the National Policy on Education 1986, Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalayas were established across rural India to nurture rural talent, offering 100% free residential education, lodging, uniforms, and meals from Class VI to XII.

exam_name: Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya Lateral Entry Selection Test for Class IX (JNV LEST Class IX)
fact: The National Migration Scheme: JNVs feature a unique cultural integration program where 30% of Class IX students from Hindi-speaking districts are migrated to non-Hindi-speaking districts (and vice versa) for one academic year to promote national integration and linguistic harmony.

exam_name: Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya Lateral Entry Selection Test for Class IX (JNV LEST Class IX)
fact: 75% Rural Child Reservation: JNV admissions strictly mandate that a minimum of 75% of total seats in each district must be filled by children admitted from rural schools, creating one of the world's most egalitarian residential schooling systems.

exam_name: Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya Lateral Entry Selection Test for Class XI (JNV LEST Class XI)
fact: Board Performance Surpassing Kendriya Vidyalayas: Despite enrolling students exclusively from non-urban and rural backgrounds, JNVs consistently record higher pass percentages in CBSE Class 10 and 12 board examinations (consistently > 98%) than Kendriya Vidyalayas and private CBSE schools.

exam_name: Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya Lateral Entry Selection Test for Class XI (JNV LEST Class XI)
fact: Free Integrated STEM & Medical Coaching: JNV Class 11 and 12 students are provided specialized in-house residential coaching for JEE Advanced and NEET-UG through CSR partnerships with organizations like the Dakshana Foundation and Avanti Fellows.

exam_name: Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya Lateral Entry Selection Test for Class XI (JNV LEST Class XI)
fact: Network of Over 650 Campus Strongholds: With one JNV sanctioned in every district of India (covering 28 States and 8 Union Territories, with the sole exception of Tamil Nadu), the network educates over 3,00,000 rural residential students simultaneously.

exam_name: Regional Institute of Education Common Entrance Examination (RIE CEE)
fact: The 1963 Pioneering Origin of Integrated B.Ed: The Regional Colleges of Education (RCEs, later renamed RIEs) were established in 1963 by NCERT with American technical assistance (from Ohio State University) to pioneer multidisciplinary 4-year integrated teacher education in India decades ahead of its time.

exam_name: Regional Institute of Education Common Entrance Examination (RIE CEE)
fact: M.Sc. Ed. Unique Degree at RIE Mysuru: RIE Mysuru offers a 6-year integrated M.Sc.Ed. in Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics (awarded by the University of Mysore), a dual-master's pedagogy qualification unique to India.

exam_name: Regional Institute of Education Common Entrance Examination (RIE CEE)
fact: Strict Regional Domicile Quota: Each of the 5 RIEs caters exclusively to a designated group of States and Union Territories (e.g., RIE Bhubaneswar for Eastern India; RIE Bhopal for Western/Central India), allocating seats strictly according to state population quotas.

exam_name: IISER Aptitude Test (IAT)
fact: The Single Gateway Reform: Starting in 2024, IISER admissions abolished the KVPY and JEE Advanced admission channels entirely, making the IISER Aptitude Test (IAT) the sole entrance channel for 100% of seats across all 7 IISERs.

exam_name: IISER Aptitude Test (IAT)
fact: Gateway to IISc and IIT Madras Medical Sciences: Top IAT scores are also directly used by the Indian Institute of Science (IISc Bengaluru) for its prestigious Bachelor of Science (Research) program and by IIT Madras for its BS in Medical Sciences & Engineering.

exam_name: IISER Aptitude Test (IAT)
fact: Equal Four-Subject Testing: Unlike JEE (PCM) or NEET (PCB), the IAT tests all four basic sciences equally—Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, and Biology (15 questions each)—demanding interdisciplinary breadth from pure science aspirants.

exam_name: National Entrance Screening Test (NEST)
fact: Department of Atomic Energy (DAE) Patronage: NISER and UM-DAE CEBS are autonomous institutes directly funded by the Department of Atomic Energy (DAE), Government of India, training India's next generation of nuclear and basic research scientists.

exam_name: National Entrance Screening Test (NEST)
fact: DISHA Annual Scholarship: All admitted students receive an annual scholarship of ₹60,000 (₹5,000/month) under the DISHA scheme of DAE, plus an annual contingency grant of ₹20,000 for summer internships.

exam_name: National Entrance Screening Test (NEST)
fact: Direct BARC Interview Gateway: Integrated M.Sc. graduates from NISER and CEBS with a CGPA of 7.5 or above are eligible for direct interview selection into the prestigious Bhabha Atomic Research Centre (BARC) Training School without appearing for the national OCES/DGFS written screening examination!

exam_name: Indian Statistical Institute (ISI) Admission Test
fact: Mahalanobis' Legacy & Institute of National Importance: Founded in 1931 by the legendary statistician Professor Prasanta Chandra Mahalanobis (architect of India's Second Five-Year Plan and the Mahalanobis Distance), ISI was declared an Institute of National Importance by an Act of Parliament in 1959.

exam_name: Indian Statistical Institute (ISI) Admission Test
fact: 100% Free Tuition & Generous Monthly Stipends: ISI charges zero tuition fees for its degree programs; every student admitted to B.Stat(Hons) and B.Math(Hons) receives a monthly stipend of ₹5,000 plus an annual contingency grant of ₹5,000!

exam_name: Indian Statistical Institute (ISI) Admission Test
fact: Direct INMO Interview Exemption: Awardees of the Indian National Mathematical Olympiad (INMO) administered by HBCSE are automatically exempted from appearing in the written entrance test for B.Stat/B.Math and called directly for the interview!

exam_name: Chennai Mathematical Institute (CMI) Entrance Examination
fact: Founded by SPIC Science Foundation: Established in 1989 as the School of Mathematics of the SPIC Science Foundation by pioneering mathematician Professor C.S. Seshadri (FRS), CMI evolved into India's premier autonomous centre for advanced mathematical sciences.

exam_name: Chennai Mathematical Institute (CMI) Entrance Examination
fact: Olympiad Medalists Direct Exemption: Students who qualify for the International Mathematical Olympiad (IMO) Training Camp (IMOTC) or represent India at the International Olympiad in Informatics (IOI) are offered direct admission to the B.Sc. (Hons.) program without appearing for the entrance exam!

exam_name: Chennai Mathematical Institute (CMI) Entrance Examination
fact: Fully Funded Fellowships & Generous Scholarships: Almost all admitted B.Sc. students receive full tuition fee waivers and a monthly stipend through institutional endowments or the DAE/NBHM scholarship programs.

exam_name: Indian Maritime University Common Entrance Test (IMU CET)
fact: Statutory Central Maritime University: Established through the Indian Maritime University Act 2008 as India's only Central University dedicated to maritime studies, absorbing legacy training colleges like the Marine Engineering and Research Institute (MERI Kolkata/Mumbai, founded 1949) and T.S. Chanakya.

exam_name: Indian Maritime University Common Entrance Test (IMU CET)
fact: Mandatory DG Shipping Medical Fitness Standards: Candidates admitted to Nautical Science and Marine Engineering must pass strict physical and eye-fitness examinations by Directorate General (DG) of Shipping approved doctors, requiring unaided 6/6 vision and zero colour blindness.

exam_name: Indian Maritime University Common Entrance Test (IMU CET)
fact: Commercial Merchant Navy Licensing: Qualifying IMU CET and completing the program is the prerequisite pathway to obtaining a Continuous Discharge Certificate (CDC) and merchant marine officer licensure from the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways.

exam_name: National Aptitude Test in Architecture (NATA)
fact: Statutory Mandate for All Architecture Admissions: Under the Architects Act 1972 and CoA Minimum Standards of Architectural Education Regulations, qualifying NATA (or JEE Main Paper 2) is a mandatory statutory prerequisite for admission to the 5-year B.Arch course at any university or college across India.

exam_name: National Aptitude Test in Architecture (NATA)
fact: Multi-Attempt Weekend Model: NATA features a candidate-friendly testing model where tests are held every weekend across a 3-month testing window (April to July), allowing candidates to appear up to 3 times, with their best score considered for admission.

exam_name: National Aptitude Test in Architecture (NATA)
fact: Hybrid Drawing and Cognitive Evaluation: Re-introduced a physical paper-based drawing test (80 marks) evaluating perspective and composition alongside computer-based visual perception and logical reasoning (120 marks).

exam_name: National Institute of Pharmaceutical Education and Research Joint Entrance Examination (NIPER JEE)
fact: Apex Institutes of National Importance in Pharma: Established under the National Institute of Pharmaceutical Education and Research Act 1998, NIPERs are statutory Institutes of National Importance under the Department of Pharmaceuticals, Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers.

exam_name: National Institute of Pharmaceutical Education and Research Joint Entrance Examination (NIPER JEE)
fact: GPAT/GATE Qualification Prerequisite: Unlike regular master's entrances, candidates applying for M.S. (Pharm.) / M.Pharm. programs must have a valid GPAT, GATE, or NET score to be eligible to sit for NIPER JEE.

exam_name: National Institute of Pharmaceutical Education and Research Joint Entrance Examination (NIPER JEE)
fact: Global Pharmacy Research Ranks: The founding institute NIPER S.A.S. Nagar (Mohali) consistently ranks in the top tier nationwide in the NIRF Pharmacy category, producing research that fuels India's status as the 'Pharmacy of the World'.

exam_name: Graduate Pharmacy Aptitude Test (GPAT)
fact: Historic Conducting Body Transition: Originally established under AICTE and later administered by NTA from 2019 to 2023, the conducting mandate of GPAT was officially transferred to the National Board of Examinations in Medical Sciences (NBEMS) in 2024, aligning it with postgraduate medical entrance standards.

exam_name: Graduate Pharmacy Aptitude Test (GPAT)
fact: Direct Gateway to AICTE PG Scholarship: GPAT qualifiers admitted to AICTE/PCI approved M.Pharm and MS (Pharm) programs receive a monthly scholarship of Rs 12,400 for 24 months, making GPAT scorecards valid for a duration of 3 continuous years for fellowship disbursement.

exam_name: Graduate Pharmacy Aptitude Test (GPAT)
fact: Strict Biometric Dual-Verification: Under NBEMS administration, GPAT enforces dual real-time web-capture during application registration alongside on-site biometric fingerprint and facial recognition at exam centers to completely eliminate impersonation.

exam_name: National Eligibility cum Entrance Test for Super Specialty (NEET-SS)
fact: The Pinnacle of Indian Medical Education: NEET-SS is the single nationwide gateway for admission to Doctorate of Medicine (DM), Master of Chirurgiae (M.Ch), and Diplomate of National Board Super Specialty (DrNB SS) courses, representing the highest clinical qualification achievable in India.

exam_name: National Eligibility cum Entrance Test for Super Specialty (NEET-SS)
fact: Grouping by Broad Specialties: In 2022, NBEMS completely reformed NEET-SS from individual super-specialty sub-tests into 13 distinct broad specialty feeder groups (Medical, Surgical, Pediatric, Anesthesiology, etc.), allowing candidates to be eligible for multiple super-specialty branches with a single examination.

exam_name: National Eligibility cum Entrance Test for Super Specialty (NEET-SS)
fact: Statutory Monolith: All super-specialty seats in India, whether in premier central government medical institutes (except INI-SS institutions like AIIMS/PGI/JIPMER/NIMHANS) or private medical universities, are strictly allotted through NEET-SS with 100% All India Quota counseling by MCC.

exam_name: National Eligibility cum Entrance Test for Master of Dental Surgery (NEET-MDS)
fact: Single Window for Dental Specialization: NEET-MDS is the sole statutory entrance test under the Dentists Act 1948 for admission to Master of Dental Surgery (MDS) across all 9 dental specialties (including Oral & Maxillofacial Surgery, Orthodontics, Prosthodontics, and Periodontics) in India.

exam_name: National Eligibility cum Entrance Test for Master of Dental Surgery (NEET-MDS)
fact: Mandatory 1-Year Compulsory Rotary Internship: Unlike many general master degrees, eligibility for NEET-MDS mandates completion of a full 12-month compulsory rotating dental internship by a strict cutoff date specified by the Dental Council of India (DCI).

exam_name: National Eligibility cum Entrance Test for Master of Dental Surgery (NEET-MDS)
fact: 240 High-Yield Questions in 180 Minutes: The NEET-MDS exam consists of 240 multiple-choice questions covering both general medical sciences (Anatomy, Physiology, Pathology, Pharmacology) and clinical dental specialties, testing extreme clinical speed and precision.

exam_name: DNB Post Diploma Centralized Entrance Test (DNB PDCET)
fact: The Secondary DNB Fast-Track: DNB PDCET allows MBBS doctors who have earned a 2-year Postgraduate Medical Diploma (such as DCH, DGO, DA, DMRD) to pursue a 2-year Secondary DNB and achieve full equivalency with an MD/MS degree under National Medical Commission regulations.

exam_name: DNB Post Diploma Centralized Entrance Test (DNB PDCET)
fact: 14 Distinct Specialty Examinations: DNB PDCET is administered across 14 specialized medical branches, from Anesthesiology, Dermatology, and Obstetrics & Gynecology to Ophthalmology, Radiodiagnosis, and Pediatrics, with distinct question papers for each discipline.

exam_name: DNB Post Diploma Centralized Entrance Test (DNB PDCET)
fact: NBEMS Accredited Hospital Network: Secondary DNB trainees under PDCET train inside India top corporate, trust, and government teaching hospitals (such as Apollo, Fortis, Max, Medanta, and Tata Memorial) with uniform national stipends mandated by NBEMS.

exam_name: Indira Gandhi National Open University B.Ed Entrance Test (IGNOU B.Ed Entrance)
fact: Asia Premier Distance Education Teacher Program: IGNOU B.Ed program is uniquely designed for in-service elementary school teachers to acquire NCTE recognized bachelor of education qualifications through distance learning combined with intensive residential workshops.

exam_name: Indira Gandhi National Open University B.Ed Entrance Test (IGNOU B.Ed Entrance)
fact: Rigid Dual-Eligibility Prerequisite: Beyond holding an undergraduate degree with 50% marks, IGNOU B.Ed admission legally requires candidates to either be trained in-service teachers in elementary education OR have completed an NCTE-recognized teacher education programme through face-to-face mode.

exam_name: Indira Gandhi National Open University B.Ed Entrance Test (IGNOU B.Ed Entrance)
fact: Massive Nationwide Reach: Conducted across hundreds of examination centers in all Indian states and Union Territories, IGNOU B.Ed provides a bilingual (Hindi and English) testing format and admits students to designated Programme Study Centres (PSCs) with strict intake caps of 50 students per PSC.

exam_name: Aligarh Muslim University Entrance Examination (AMU Entrance incl. AMUEEE)
fact: Institution of Historic Stature: Founded in 1875 by Sir Syed Ahmad Khan as the Muhammadan Anglo-Oriental (MAO) College and upgraded to a Central University in 1920, AMU is one of India oldest and most prestigious residential universities, spanning 467 hectares and 13 faculties.

exam_name: Aligarh Muslim University Entrance Examination (AMU Entrance incl. AMUEEE)
fact: Zakir Husain College of Engineering & Technology (ZHCET): AMUEEE is the dedicated engineering entrance exam for ZHCET, established in 1935, which counts among India foremost engineering colleges with its own wind tunnel, solar thermal test centre, and supercomputing labs.

exam_name: Aligarh Muslim University Entrance Examination (AMU Entrance incl. AMUEEE)
fact: Internal vs External Quota Heritage: AMU maintains an institutional tradition where 50% of seats in professional courses are allocated to "Internal" candidates (who studied in AMU schools/colleges for at least 3 years), creating intense competition for the remaining open All-India seats.

exam_name: Banaras Hindu University Special Courses of Study & Research Entrance (BHU SCS / RET)
fact: Mahamana Pandit Madan Mohan Malaviya Vision: Founded in 1916 under the BHU Act, Banaras Hindu University is Asia largest residential university, sprawling over 1,300 acres in Varanasi with 140 teaching departments and 40,000+ students from 48 countries.

exam_name: Banaras Hindu University Special Courses of Study & Research Entrance (BHU SCS / RET)
fact: Niche Professional Disciplines Under SCS: While general UG/PG admissions moved to CUET, BHU Special Courses of Study (SCS) independently administer unique industry-oriented degrees including PG Diploma in Forensic Science, Micropropagation, Geo-informatics, Conflict Resolution, and Ayurvedic Drug Standardization.

exam_name: Banaras Hindu University Special Courses of Study & Research Entrance (BHU SCS / RET)
fact: Research Entrance Test (RET) Legacy: The BHU RET entrance examination tests deep subject-specific research acumen and research methodology, awarding Institute Research Fellowships to top doctoral scholars across science, arts, engineering, and humanities.

exam_name: Military Nursing Service B.Sc. Nursing Course Entrance (Indian Army MNS)
fact: Direct Permanent / Short Service Commission: Successful female candidates who complete the 4-year B.Sc. Nursing program at Armed Forces Medical Services colleges are directly commissioned into the Military Nursing Service (MNS) as Lieutenant in the Indian Army with full officer pay and status.

exam_name: Military Nursing Service B.Sc. Nursing Course Entrance (Indian Army MNS)
fact: Century-Old Service Heritage: The Military Nursing Service has a celebrated lineage dating back to 1888 when the first batch of British Army nurses arrived in India, evolving in 1943 into a regular commissioned corps of the Indian Armed Forces under the MNS Ordinance.

exam_name: Military Nursing Service B.Sc. Nursing Course Entrance (Indian Army MNS)
fact: Four-Tier Competitive Screening: Following qualification in NTA NEET-UG, candidates undergo a Test of General Intelligence & General English (ToGIGE), followed by a Psychological Assessment Test (PAT), Personal Interview, and rigorous Military Special Medical Board (SMB) evaluation.

exam_name: Postgraduate Institute of Medical Education & Research B.Sc. Nursing Entrance (PGIMER B.Sc Nursing)
fact: National Institute of Nursing Education (NINE): PGIMER nursing programs are conducted by the prestigious National Institute of Nursing Education (NINE), a designated WHO Collaborating Centre for Nursing and Midwifery Development in South-East Asia.

exam_name: Postgraduate Institute of Medical Education & Research B.Sc. Nursing Entrance (PGIMER B.Sc Nursing)
fact: Independent Entrance Testing Autonomy: While many central institutions surrendered autonomous UG entrance tests to NEET-UG or CUET, PGIMER Chandigarh retains its statutory autonomy under an Act of Parliament (1966), conducting its own independent CBT across India for B.Sc Nursing and Post-Basic Nursing.

exam_name: Postgraduate Institute of Medical Education & Research B.Sc. Nursing Entrance (PGIMER B.Sc Nursing)
fact: Rigid Name-and-Date Placard Tradition: PGIMER enforces one of India most specific photograph upload protocols: candidates must physically hold a placard showing their name and the exact date the photo was taken, a rule strictly designed to eliminate impersonation and outdated passport photos.

exam_name: Jawaharlal Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education & Research B.Sc Nursing Admission (JIPMER B.Sc Nursing)
fact: Colonial French Heritage to Institute of National Importance: Tracing its origin to the Ecole de Medecine de Pondichery established by the French Government in 1823, JIPMER was handed over to the Government of India in 1956 and declared an Institute of National Importance in 2008.

exam_name: Jawaharlal Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education & Research B.Sc Nursing Admission (JIPMER B.Sc Nursing)
fact: Mandatory Physical Placard & Strict File Naming: JIPMER mandates that candidates hold a physical placard with their name and date of photo in front of their chest (digital addition causes rejection) and strictly requires files to be named "Candidate Photograph.jpg" and "Candidate Signature.jpg".

exam_name: Jawaharlal Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education & Research B.Sc Nursing Admission (JIPMER B.Sc Nursing)
fact: Co-Educational Nursing Degree: Unlike many military and central nursing institutes that exclusively admit female candidates, JIPMER College of Nursing offers co-educational B.Sc Nursing, reserving specific quota seats (typically 9 seats) for male candidates alongside female candidates.

exam_name: Central Pool MBBS/BDS Seats Allocation - UT Ladakh Quota
fact: Sovereign Medical Access for Remote Borderland: Because the Union Territory of Ladakh does not yet possess an operational medical college of its own, the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare allocates Central Pool MBBS and BDS seats annually in premier medical colleges across India (including Lady Hardinge, MAMC Delhi, and LLRM Meerut) specifically to Ladakh ST youth.

exam_name: Central Pool MBBS/BDS Seats Allocation - UT Ladakh Quota
fact: Historic 2026 Policy Overhaul (Single Merit List): On September 22, 2026, the UT Administration of Ladakh abolished the previous complex roster and district/gender quotas, instituting a transparent "Single Merit List" based purely on NEET All India Rank for all Central Pool medical seats.

exam_name: Central Pool MBBS/BDS Seats Allocation - UT Ladakh Quota
fact: Service Bond Commitment for Frontier Healthcare: Candidates allotted Central Pool seats execute a mandatory service bond with the UT Ladakh Health Department pledging to serve in the harsh high-altitude terrain of Leh and Kargil districts upon completing their MBBS degree.

exam_name: Common Law Admission Test (CLAT UG & PG)
fact: Supreme Court Mandated Birth: CLAT was born in 2008 following a landmark Public Interest Litigation (Varun Bhagat v. Union of India) in the Supreme Court, which directed the then existing seven NLUs to replace fragmented separate entrance tests with a single unified national entrance exam.

exam_name: Common Law Admission Test (CLAT UG & PG)
fact: Comprehension-Centric Paradigm Shift: In 2020, the Consortium revolutionized the CLAT question format, eliminating rote-memory trivia and converting all 120 questions into reading comprehension passage-based inquiries across Legal Reasoning, Logical Reasoning, English, and Current Affairs.

exam_name: Common Law Admission Test (CLAT UG & PG)
fact: Winter Testing Cycle Tradition: Unlike almost all Indian entrance exams held during spring or summer (April to June), CLAT is uniquely conducted in the dead of winter (first Sunday of December) for admissions commencing in the subsequent academic session.

exam_name: All India Law Entrance Test (AILET)
fact: The Great NLU Solitary Outlier: Established under Delhi Act No. 1 of 2008, National Law University Delhi famously chose never to join the Consortium of NLUs, fiercely preserving its independent statutory identity and conducting its own highly selective AILET exam.

exam_name: All India Law Entrance Test (AILET)
fact: Extreme Selection Ratio: With approximately 25,000 applicants competing for just 123 undergraduate seats, AILET exhibits an acceptance rate under 0.5%, making it statistically more selective than Harvard Law or Oxford Jurisprudence.

exam_name: All India Law Entrance Test (AILET)
fact: Radical Removal of Mathematics: In a major pedagogical overhaul, NLU Delhi completely eliminated the Elementary Mathematics section from AILET, redesigning the 120-minute test exclusively around three sections: English Language, Current Affairs & General Knowledge, and Logical Reasoning.

exam_name: Army Institute of Law Law Entrance Test (AIL LET)
fact: Inaugurated by APJ Abdul Kalam: Founded in 1999 at Patiala and shifted to its sprawling permanent campus in Sector 68, Mohali in 2003, AIL Mohali was inaugurated by the 11th President of India, Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam.

exam_name: Army Institute of Law Law Entrance Test (AIL LET)
fact: Judge Advocate General (JAG) Pipeline: Managed by the Army Welfare Education Society (AWES), AIL Mohali is the primary institutional training ground for officers entering the Indian Army legal wing (Judge Advocate General Branch), alongside top corporate law firms.

exam_name: Army Institute of Law Law Entrance Test (AIL LET)
fact: Strict 80% Military Wards Quota: Out of the 100 sanctioned BA.LL.B seats, exactly 80 are strictly reserved for wards of serving or retired Indian Army personnel, requiring commanding officers to sign service eligibility certificates for application validation.

exam_name: Alliance University Common Law Entrance Test (AICLET / ACLAT)
fact: Dual Bar Council & International Accreditation: Alliance School of Law is recognized by the Bar Council of India (BCI) and features extensive international student exchange partnerships with institutions in the US, UK, and Europe.

exam_name: Alliance University Common Law Entrance Test (AICLET / ACLAT)
fact: Moot Court Excellence Tradition: Alliance School of Law hosts the renowned Justice N. Santosh Hegde National Moot Court Competition, drawing top law student advocates from across South Asia.

exam_name: Symbiosis Law Admission Test (SLAT)
fact: Five Decades of Legal Pedagogy: Tracing its root to Symbiosis Law School (SLS) Pune established in 1977, SLAT admits students to an institution that pioneered the 5-year integrated law degree in western India.

exam_name: Symbiosis Law Admission Test (SLAT)
fact: Two-Attempt Best-Score Privilege: SLAT allows candidates the option of appearing in both test dates in May, with Symbiosis calculating merit strictly on the percentile from their higher-scoring attempt.

exam_name: NMIMS Law Aptitude Test (NMIMS LAT)
fact: Corporate Law Specialization Hub: Kirit P. Mehta School of Law (KPMSOL) at NMIMS Mumbai integrates management and corporate finance deeply into its law curriculum, leveraging NMIMS legendary business pedigree.

exam_name: NMIMS Law Aptitude Test (NMIMS LAT)
fact: Retake Flexibility Model: Candidates taking NMIMS LAT are permitted up to two retakes within the testing window (main exam plus 2 retakes), empowering applicants to optimize their test performance.

exam_name: All India Bar Examination (AIBE)
fact: Statutory Right to Practice Law: Created by the Bar Council of India under the Advocates Act 1961, passing AIBE is legally mandatory for any law graduate enrolled in a State Bar Council to obtain a permanent Certificate of Practice (COP) to represent clients in Indian courts.

exam_name: All India Bar Examination (AIBE)
fact: The Supreme Court Constitution Bench Milestone: In 2023, a 5-judge Constitution Bench of the Supreme Court of India (Bar Council of India v. Bonnie FOI Law College) unequivocally upheld the validity of AIBE, establishing the BCI absolute constitutional authority to conduct pre-enrollment or post-enrollment qualifying bar exams.

exam_name: All India Bar Examination (AIBE)
fact: Multilingual Open Book Examination: AIBE is administered in 11 different Indian languages across 50+ cities, and candidates are legally permitted to carry physical unannotated Bare Acts directly into the examination hall.

exam_name: AIMS Test for Management Admissions (ATMA)
fact: Supreme Court of India Recognized Test: ATMA is one of the six national tests officially recognized by the Ministry of Education (Govt. of India) and the Supreme Court of India for admission to all AICTE-approved PGDM/MBA programs.

exam_name: AIMS Test for Management Admissions (ATMA)
fact: Pioneer of True Color Scanning Standards: ATMA was among the earliest management test secretariats to mandate strict scanner configuration instructions ("True Color" at 200 DPI) to prevent loss of facial fidelity in hall tickets.

exam_name: Symbiosis National Aptitude Test (SNAP)
fact: The 60-Minute Blitzkrieg: While most MBA tests span 120 to 180 minutes, SNAP is an ultra-fast 60-minute test consisting of 60 questions, testing raw speed, mental endurance, and instant analytical clarity.

exam_name: Symbiosis National Aptitude Test (SNAP)
fact: Three-Attempt Best-Score System: SNAP candidates can appear up to three times during the December exam window, with Symbiosis considering the highest overall score among all attempts for shortlisting.

exam_name: NMAT by GMAC
fact: Acquisition by GMAC: Originally conceived by NMIMS Mumbai, the examination was acquired in 2015 by the Graduate Management Admission Council (GMAC, creators of the GMAT), turning NMAT into a global standardized testing platform used across India, South Africa, Nigeria, and the Philippines.

exam_name: NMAT by GMAC
fact: Zero Negative Marking: Unique among premier national MBA tests in India, NMAT incorporates no negative marking for incorrect answers, encouraging candidates to complete every question within timed sections.

exam_name: MICA Admission Test (MICAT I and II)
fact: India Only Marketing & Creative Thinking Entrance: MICA Ahmedabad is celebrated as "The School of Ideas". Unlike conventional MBA tests, Section C of MICAT consists of Creative Descriptive Writing, requiring candidates to write original stories based on abstract pictures and argue socio-political essays.

exam_name: MICA Admission Test (MICAT I and II)
fact: Mandatory Psychometric Elimination Gate: Section A of MICAT is a specialized Psychometric Test that assesses alignment with MICA creative ethos; failing to clear the psychometric test leads to immediate disqualification without evaluation of the rest of the paper.

exam_name: ICFAI Business School Aptitude Test (IBSAT)
fact: Massive Case-Study Pedagogy: ICFAI Business School is one of the world largest contributors of business case studies to Harvard Business Publishing and The Case Centre UK, second only to Harvard Business School.

exam_name: ICFAI Business School Aptitude Test (IBSAT)
fact: Pioneer of Home-Proctored B-School Tests: IBSAT was among the first national examinations to adopt a 100% remote-proctored format from candidates homes using AI facial tracking and human proctors.

exam_name: Integrated Programme in Management Aptitude Test - IIM Indore (IPMAT Indore)
fact: India First 5-Year Integrated Management Degree: Launched in 2011 under visionary Director Dr. N. Ravichandran, IIM Indore IPM was the first program in the Indian Institute of Management family to admit students straight out of Class 12, awarding a dual BA (Foundations of Management) and MBA.

exam_name: Integrated Programme in Management Aptitude Test - IIM Indore (IPMAT Indore)
fact: High-Math Short Answer (SA) Challenge: IPMAT Indore includes non-MCQ "Short Answer" Quantitative Ability questions with no multiple-choice options and zero negative marking, testing pure mathematical derivation under pressure.

exam_name: Integrated Programme in Management Aptitude Test - IIM Rohtak (IPMAT Rohtak)
fact: The NCR Strategic Management Hub: Started in 2019, IIM Rohtak IPM leverages its proximity to the National Capital Region to offer immersion in public policy and corporate consulting, featuring 180 seats.

exam_name: Integrated Programme in Management Aptitude Test - IIM Rohtak (IPMAT Rohtak)
fact: Inclusion of Logical Reasoning: Unlike IPMAT Indore which focuses heavily on advanced mathematics, IPMAT Rohtak allocates equal 40-question weightage to Logical Reasoning alongside Quantitative Ability and Verbal Ability.

exam_name: Kerala Management Aptitude Test (KMAT Kerala)
fact: State Statutory Admission Mandate: KMAT Kerala is conducted under the supervision of the Admission Supervisory Committee for Professional Colleges, ensuring fair and transparent merit admissions across 150+ MBA colleges in Kerala.

exam_name: Kerala Management Aptitude Test (KMAT Kerala)
fact: 720-Mark Comprehensive Examination: KMAT Kerala is a 180-question test carrying 720 marks, testing English, Quantitative Aptitude, Data Sufficiency/Logical Reasoning, and General Knowledge with a 15% qualifying cutoff.

exam_name: Tamil Nadu Common Entrance Test for MBA/MCA (TANCET MBA)
fact: Single Window for Tamil Nadu State B-Schools: Administered by the prestigious Anna University (College of Engineering Guindy), TANCET is the mandatory statutory gateway for government quota seats across University Departments, Government Engineering Colleges, and top self-financing institutes.

exam_name: Tamil Nadu Common Entrance Test for MBA/MCA (TANCET MBA)
fact: Business Situations Analysis Section: Uniquely tailored for management education, Section I of the TANCET MBA paper presents complex real-world business scenarios to evaluate candidates managerial decision-making capacity.

exam_name: CHRIST University Entrance Test / MBA Selection Process
fact: Triple International Accreditations: CHRIST University School of Business and Management is accredited by AACSB (Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business), placing it among the top 5% of business schools globally.

exam_name: CHRIST University Entrance Test / MBA Selection Process
fact: The 90-Second Micro-Presentation Tradition: A signature element of the CHRIST selection process is the mandatory "Micro Presentation", where each candidate is given an extempore topic and must deliver a structured 90-second speech before the evaluation panel.

exam_name: KIITEE Management Entrance Exam (KIITEE Management)
fact: Founder Dr. Achyuta Samanta Vision: KSOM is the flagship management school of KIIT University, which supports Kalinga Institute of Social Sciences (KISS) - the world largest free residential institute for 30,000+ indigenous tribal children.

exam_name: KIITEE Management Entrance Exam (KIITEE Management)
fact: Zero Application Fee Heritage: Unlike almost all private business schools charging ₹1,500 to ₹3,000 per application, KIITEE Management has maintained a longstanding policy of charging zero or nominal fees to promote widespread accessibility.

exam_name: Footwear Design & Development Institute All India Selection Test (FDDI AIST)
fact: Institute of National Importance (INI) Under Commerce Ministry: Established in 1986 under the aegis of the Ministry of Commerce & Industry, Government of India, FDDI was declared an Institute of National Importance by an Act of Parliament (FDDI Act 2017), elevating it alongside IITs, IIMs, and NIFTs.

exam_name: Footwear Design & Development Institute All India Selection Test (FDDI AIST)
fact: Global Pioneer in Leather & Footwear Engineering: FDDI is one of the world few premier specialized institutes dedicated to Footwear Design, Leather Goods & Accessories, and Fashion Merchandising, equipped with advanced German, Italian, and British computerized shoe-design testing laboratories.

exam_name: All India Entrance Examination for Design (AIEED)
fact: Design Thinking Screen (DTS) Methodology: AIEED was among the earliest Indian design entrances to discard mechanical multiple-choice testing in favor of a holistic "Design Thinking Screen", evaluating creative problem solving, psychological perception, and social awareness.

exam_name: All India Entrance Examination for Design (AIEED)
fact: Global Design Alliances: ARCH College of Design & Business in Jaipur is a voting member of the World Design Organization (WDO) and CUMULUS, maintaining academic articulation agreements with Manchester Metropolitan University and Pearson BTEC UK.

exam_name: MIT Design Aptitude Test (MIT DAT / MITID)
fact: Rajbaug Cultural Heritage Campus: Situated on the picturesque 125-acre Rajbaug campus in Loni Kalbhor, Pune, MIT Institute of Design stands on the erstwhile private farm estate of the legendary Bollywood showman Raj Kapoor, which was dedicated to art, design, and world peace.

exam_name: MIT Design Aptitude Test (MIT DAT / MITID)
fact: Automotive & Industrial Design Powerhouse: MITID is widely regarded across Indian automotive manufacturing as a prime design talent incubator, with alumni designing flagship vehicles for Tata Motors, Mahindra, Bajaj, and global European styling houses.

exam_name: Pearl Academy Design & Fashion Entrance Exam
fact: Three Decades of Fashion Pedagogy: Founded in 1993, Pearl Academy was one of India earliest private design schools to introduce international curriculum frameworks, partnering with the Fashion Institute of Technology (FIT) New York and London College of Fashion.

exam_name: Pearl Academy Design & Fashion Entrance Exam
fact: Runway Showcase at London Fashion Week: Pearl Academy regularly presents collections conceived and manufactured by its graduating student designers at prestigious international runways including London Fashion Week and FDCI Amazon India Fashion Week.

exam_name: Symbiosis Entrance Exam for Design (SEED)
fact: Viman Nagar Design Hub: Symbiosis Institute of Design (SID) Pune is located in the vibrant student quarter of Viman Nagar, featuring eight distinct design specializations spanning Product Design, User Experience (UX) Design, Animation Film Design, and Fashion Communication.

exam_name: Symbiosis Entrance Exam for Design (SEED)
fact: Rigorous Digital Portfolio Review (PRPI): Clearing the SEED CBT is merely stage one; final admission requires candidates to present a structured digital portfolio of sketches, models, and personal craft projects before a jury of industry leaders and SID professors.

exam_name: Ajeenkya DY Patil University Design Aptitude Test (ACET / AIDAT)
fact: Innovation University Philosophy: Conceived by Dr. Ajeenkya D.Y. Patil, ADYPU was founded on the concept of an "Innovation University", pioneering specialized programs in Automotive Styling and Transportation Design developed in collaboration with legendary Italian car design studios.

exam_name: Ajeenkya DY Patil University Design Aptitude Test (ACET / AIDAT)
fact: Full-Scale Clay Modeling Studios: Unlike typical theoretical classrooms, ADYPU School of Design houses full-scale automotive clay modeling setups and 3D prototyping bays identical to commercial automotive styling studios.

exam_name: Amrita Entrance Examination - Engineering (AEEE)
fact: Chancellor Mata Amritanandamayi Devi: Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham is guided by internationally renowned humanitarian Mata Amritanandamayi Devi (Amma), ranked among India top 10 universities by NIRF consistently and holding Category-1 graded autonomy from UGC.

exam_name: Amrita Entrance Examination - Engineering (AEEE)
fact: Cyber Security & Autonomous Systems Hub: Amrita is home to Team bi0s, India #1 ranked student cybersecurity and Capture-the-Flag (CTF) research team, making AEEE highly sought-after by students targeting computer science and cybersecurity.

exam_name: Consortium of Medical, Engineering & Dental Colleges of Karnataka Under Graduate Entrance Test (COMEDK UGET)
fact: Historic Consortium of Merit: Founded in 2004–05, COMEDK represents 190+ autonomous and private unaided engineering colleges across Karnataka, including landmark institutions like RVCE, BMSCE, and MSRIT, providing an All-India open-merit window outside Karnataka state domicile.

exam_name: Consortium of Medical, Engineering & Dental Colleges of Karnataka Under Graduate Entrance Test (COMEDK UGET)
fact: Mandatory Upload of Selected Photo ID: A distinctive feature of the COMEDK application is that candidates must upload a scanned copy of the exact photo ID card (Aadhaar/Passport/Voter ID) they plan to physically carry to the exam center, with automated algorithmic matching during entrance verification.

exam_name: Vellore Institute of Technology Engineering Entrance Examination (VITEEE)
fact: Scale & Global Footprint: Founded in 1984 by Dr. G. Viswanathan as Vellore Engineering College, VIT hosts over 40,000 students on its 372-acre eco-friendly campus, attracting over 2.2 lakh applicants annually for VITEEE across India and overseas test centers in Dubai, Muscat, and Qatar.

exam_name: Vellore Institute of Technology Engineering Entrance Examination (VITEEE)
fact: Equi-Percentile Rank Normalization: VITEEE employs a sophisticated equi-percentile ranking method to ensure fairness across multiple sessions, awarding transparent national ranks without negative marking on questions.

exam_name: SRM Joint Engineering Entrance Examination (SRMJEEE)
fact: India Largest Single Private Campus Cohort: SRMIST Kattankulathur campus spans over 250 acres with 43 buildings, hosting over 50,000 students from 52 countries and offering state-of-the-art supercomputing facilities and nanotech research centers.

exam_name: SRM Joint Engineering Entrance Examination (SRMJEEE)
fact: SRMSAT Satellite Legacy: In 2011, SRM University became one of the first private universities in India to successfully design, build, and launch its own nano-satellite (SRMSAT) into space aboard ISRO PSLV-C18 rocket to monitor greenhouse gases.

exam_name: Manipal Entrance Test (MET)
fact: Alma Mater of Global Tech Titans: Manipal Institute of Technology (MIT), established in 1957 by Dr. T.M.A. Pai as India first self-financing engineering college, counts Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella and Nokia former CEO Rajeev Suri among its distinguished alumni.

exam_name: Manipal Entrance Test (MET)
fact: Institute of Eminence (IoE) Conferred: MAHE Manipal is one of the few elite private institutions awarded the prestigious "Institute of Eminence" status by the Government of India, granting complete autonomy in academic curricula, foreign faculty hiring, and research collaborations.

exam_name: Symbiosis Institute of Technology Engineering Entrance Exam (SITEEE)
fact: Engineering with Liberal Arts Balance: Operating under Symbiosis International, SIT integrates engineering rigor with liberal arts, foreign languages, and business administration, requiring students to complete interdisciplinary minors.

exam_name: Symbiosis Institute of Technology Engineering Entrance Exam (SITEEE)
fact: International Semester Exchange: SIT maintains mandatory global student mobility programs, sending students to partner universities in Germany, the US, and Singapore for academic semesters and joint research projects.

exam_name: Symbiosis Entrance Test for General Undergraduate Programs (SET General)
fact: Vasudhaiva Kutumbakam Ethos: Founded in 1971 by Padma Bhushan Dr. S.B. Mujumdar to promote international understanding and welfare of foreign students in Pune, Symbiosis International has grown into a 40,000-student global academic powerhouse.

exam_name: Symbiosis Entrance Test for General Undergraduate Programs (SET General)

exam_name: UP Police Sub-Inspector (Civil Police) / Platoon Commander PAC / FSSO Recruitment
fact: Sectional 35% and Overall 50% Cut-Off & DigiLocker Integration: UPPRPB requires candidates to score at least 35% in each of the four individual sections (General Hindi, Law/Constitution/GK, Numerical Ability, Mental Ability) and 50% overall in the written test. Educational certificates can be uploaded directly via DigiLocker.

exam_name: Uttarakhand Police Sub-Inspector & Police Constable Direct Recruitment Examination
fact: UKSSSC vs UKPSC Split Jurisdiction: Sub-Inspector and Fire Station Second Officer recruitments are conducted by UKPSC (requiring 150x200 px photo and signature 10-20 KB), while Constable posts are examined by UKSSSC (requiring additional Left Thumb Impression upload).

exam_name: West Bengal Police Sub-Inspector & Police Constable Direct Recruitment Examination
fact: Rigid White Background Auto-Rejection: WBPRB application software incorporates an automated image analyzer that rejects any photograph with a colored, non-white, or patterned background. Running signatures in capital letters or initials result in outright rejection without refund.

exam_name: Delhi Police Head Constable (Ministerial & AWO / TPO) Examination
fact: Discontinuation of Scanned Photo Uploads: Under the unified SSC architecture launched in 2024, pre-scanned photo uploads are permanently abolished; candidates must capture their live face via webcam or the MySSC mobile app. Spectacles or caps during live capture result in automatic rejection.

exam_name: Chandigarh Police Assistant Sub-Inspector & Police Constable Direct Recruitment
fact: Compulsory LMV Driving License and 80-Hour Computer CCC Course: Male applicants must possess a valid LMV driving license on application closing date. All candidates must complete a minimum 80-hour Computer Concepts Course (CCC) from a government-recognized institution before appointment.

exam_name: Andaman & Nicobar Police Sub-Inspector & Police Constable Direct Recruitment
fact: Island Category Quota: 100% of executive police constable posts in Andaman & Nicobar Police are reserved for permanent local residents divided into four distinct categories (Pre-1942 settlers, Nicobarese/tribals, repatriates, and mainland settlers residing since specified cut-off dates).

exam_name: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu Police Constable & SI Direct Recruitment
fact: 85% Domicile Reservation in UT Administration: Group C uniformed police posts in DNHDD enforce an 85% local reservation for candidates possessing a valid Domicile Certificate issued by the UT Administration.

exam_name: Karnataka Prisons Department Jailor & Warder Direct Recruitment Examination
fact: Triple Upload Verification (Photo, Sign, Thumb) & Article 371(J): Applicants must upload photo (20-50 KB), signature (10-20 KB), and Left Thumb Impression (10-20 KB). Candidates from the Kalyana Karnataka region (Bidar, Ballari, Kalaburagi, Koppal, Raichur, Yadgir, Vijayanagara) receive localized reservation under Article 371(J).

exam_name: Jharkhand Combined Police Sub-Inspector Competitive Examination (JCPSICE)
fact: Rigid Physical Efficiency Run (10 km in 60 min for Males): Following written examination, candidates undergo a qualifying 10-kilometer run in 60 minutes for male candidates (5 km in 40 minutes for female candidates) monitored via RFID chip tracking.

exam_name: Meghalaya Civil Defence & Home Guards Direct Recruitment Examination
fact: Weightage for Trained Home Guard Volunteers: In Meghalaya Civil Defence & Home Guards recruitment, registered Home Guard volunteers who have completed basic and advanced training get formal weightage marks and upper-age relaxations.

exam_name: Jharkhand Home Defense Corps (Home Guard) Volunteer Enrolment Examination
fact: Hyper-Local Block Level Selection: Jharkhand Home Guard volunteer enrolments are conducted at the individual Community Development (CD) block level for rural volunteers and municipal corporation level for urban volunteers; applicants cannot apply outside their home block.

exam_name: Arunachal Pradesh Teacher Eligibility Test & TGT Recruitment Examination
fact: APST Quota Dominance: Over 80% of secondary and elementary teaching posts recruited through APPSC / Education Department are reserved for Arunachal Pradesh Scheduled Tribes (APST), requiring an APST certificate uploaded during online application.

exam_name: Assam Teacher Eligibility Test (Assam TET & Special TET)
fact: 6th Schedule Special TET Autonomous Councils: Assam conducts Special TET for Sixth Schedule autonomous council areas (Bodoland Territorial Region, Dima Hasao, Karbi Anglong) with region-specific mother tongue language requirements (Bodo, Karbi, Dimasa, Bengali, Assamese).

exam_name: Chhattisgarh Teacher Eligibility Test (CG TET)
fact: Lifetime Validity & Free Application Fee for CG Domiciles: CG TET certificates have lifetime validity as per NCTE guidelines. Under Chhattisgarh Government policy, candidates with CG domicile are completely exempt from examination fees on the CG Vyapam portal.

exam_name: Chhattisgarh School Education Teacher Recruitment (Assistant Teacher / Teacher / Lecturer)
fact: Guest Teacher (Atithi Shikshak) Bonus Marks: In CG Vyapam teacher recruitment, serving guest teachers in government schools are awarded up to 10 bonus experience marks (2 marks per completed academic year) added to their written examination score.

exam_name: Gujarat Teacher Eligibility Test (Gujarat TET-I & TET-II)
fact: Strict 15 KB Server Upload Limit on OJAS / SEB: Both photo (130x180 px) and signature (275x90 px) must not exceed 15 KB. If the file size is 15.1 KB, the OJAS application engine automatically triggers an error and blocks form submission.

exam_name: Gujarat Teacher Aptitude Test (Gujarat TAT - Secondary & Higher Secondary)
fact: Two-Tier Examination Structure (Prelims & Mains Descriptive): Unlike standard TET exams which are single-stage objective tests, Gujarat TAT incorporates a preliminary objective screening test followed by a descriptive Mains examination testing Gujarati/English language skills and subject pedagogy.

exam_name: Gujarat Head Teacher Aptitude Test (Gujarat HTAT)
fact: 5-Year Mandatory Primary Teaching Service Prerequisite: HTAT is specialized for appointment of Head Teachers (Prathmik Shala Acharya) in Gujarat primary schools; only candidates with 5 years continuous teaching experience in primary/upper primary schools certified by DPEO are eligible.

exam_name: Himachal Pradesh Teacher Eligibility Test (HP TET - JBT / TGT Arts / Non-Med / Med / Shastri / Urdu / Punjabi)
fact: Rigid 15-20 KB Narrow File Size Window: HPBOSE enforces an exceptionally strict file size range on its portal: the photograph must strictly be between 15 KB and 20 KB (135x175 px) and the signature between 10 KB and 15 KB (135x55 px). Files outside these bounds are rejected.

exam_name: Jharkhand Teacher Eligibility Test (JTET - Level 1 & Level 2)
fact: Regional & Tribal Language Compulsion: In JTET, Paper I and Paper II candidates must choose and qualify in a recognized regional or tribal language of Jharkhand (Khortha, Santhali, Mundari, Ho, Kurukh, Kurmali, Nagpuri, Panchpargania, etc.) mapped to their respective district.

exam_name: Kerala Teacher Eligibility Test (KTET - Category I, II, III & IV)
fact: Mandatory Printed Name and Date on 150x200 px Photograph: KTET requires a 150x200 px photo (20-30 KB) with the candidate name and photo capture date legibly printed on a white strip at the bottom. Separate papers cover Lower Primary (Cat I), Upper Primary (Cat II), High School (Cat III), and Language/Specialist Teachers (Cat IV).

exam_name: Karnataka Graduate Primary Teacher Recruitment (GPTR Classes 6-8) & High School Teacher Exam
fact: Composite Merit Score Formula & Triple Uploads: Final selection for GPTR combines 50% written examination score, 20% Degree marks, 10% B.Ed/D.El.Ed marks, and 20% KARTET/CTET score. The portal requires candidate photo, signature, and Left Thumb Impression uploads.

exam_name: Manipur Teacher Eligibility Test (MTET) and Primary / Graduate Teacher Recruitment
fact: Manipuri Language & Meetei Mayek Script Component: Candidates appearing for MTET in Manipur must demonstrate proficiency in Manipuri language (in Bengali or Meetei Mayek script) or recognized tribal dialects of hill districts.

exam_name: Meghalaya Teacher Eligibility Test (MTET - Lower Primary & Upper Primary)
fact: Khasi and Garo Mother Tongue Options: In Meghalaya MTET, Language-I is mandatory as either Khasi, Garo, Assamese, Bengali, Hindi, Nepali, or Urdu, catering to the cultural and linguistic requirements of Khasi Hills, Jaintia Hills, and Garo Hills districts.

exam_name: Mizoram Teacher Eligibility Test (Mizoram TET - Paper I & Paper II)
fact: Mizo Language Compulsion: In Mizoram TET conducted by MBSE, Language-I is compulsory as Mizo language for primary and upper primary levels, testing local pedagogical vocabulary and grammar.

exam_name: MP Middle School Teacher Selection Test (MSTST)
fact: Selection Test vs Eligibility Test Two-Tier Architecture: Candidates can appear for MSTST only after qualifying the MP Middle School Teacher Eligibility Test (TET). The portal enforces the composite single-page profile template (<= 220 KB JPG) containing photo with printed name/date, signature, and handwritten text.

exam_name: Nagaland Teacher Eligibility Test (Nagaland TET)
fact: Indigenous Inhabitant Requirement: Teacher recruitments in Nagaland enforce strict domicile and Indigenous Inhabitant Certificate (IIC) rules, with preferential quotas for recognized backward tribes across remote hill districts.

exam_name: Odisha Teacher Eligibility Test (OTET)
fact: Strict 150x200 px Resolution on BSE Odisha Portal: OTET enforces exact dimension checks (150x200 px for photo, 150x60 px for signature). Candidates must have passed Odia as an examination subject up to Class VII / X.

exam_name: Odisha Secondary School Teacher Eligibility Test (OSSTET)
fact: Paper-I (General Subjects) & Paper-II (Physical Education): OSSTET is specifically tailored for secondary school teachers (Classes 9-10). Paper-II tests physical education theory, physiology, and sports pedagogy for PET appointments.

exam_name: Odisha Adarsha Vidyalaya Sangathan (OAVS) Principal & Teacher Recruitment
fact: Elevated TCS iON File Sizes & CBSE English Medium Standard: OAVS runs on TCS iON platform enforcing 50-100 KB photo and 10-50 KB signature. Candidates must be fluent in teaching in English medium as Adarsha Vidyalayas follow the CBSE curriculum.

exam_name: Punjab State Teacher Eligibility Test (PSTET)
fact: Compulsory Punjabi at Matric Level: To be eligible for PSTET and subsequent teaching recruitment in Punjab schools, passing Punjabi language at Matriculation level is an absolute statutory prerequisite.

exam_name: Sikkim Teacher Eligibility Test (STET for In-Service Teachers & Fresh Candidates)
fact: In-Service Special Sessions & Local Dialect Options: Sikkim conducts specialized STET rounds for ad-hoc and in-service teachers to regularize their tenure under NCTE norms, offering Paper I/II language options in Bhutia, Lepcha, Limboo, and Nepali.

exam_name: Tamil Nadu Teacher Eligibility Test (TNTET - Paper I & Paper II)
fact: Mandatory Printed Name and Date on Photo & TRB Scrutiny: TNTET automatically rejects photographs lacking the candidate name and photo capture date in capital letters on a white strip. PSTM candidates (studied in Tamil medium from schooling through degree) receive 20% reservation in teacher appointments.

exam_name: Tripura Teacher Eligibility Test (T-TET - Paper I & Paper II)
fact: Kokborok / Bengali Language Options & PRTC Mandate: T-TET requires candidates to hold a valid PRTC of Tripura. Candidates can opt for Kokborok or Bengali as Language-I, reflecting the linguistic demographics of Tripura.

exam_name: Tripura Selection Test for Graduate Teachers & Post Graduate Teachers (STGT & STPGT)
fact: Subject-Specific Direct Recruitment without Interview: TRBT conducts STGT and STPGT based strictly on merit in a single-stage 150-mark written test without an interview, ensuring transparent recruitment for high school and higher secondary teachers.

exam_name: Uttar Pradesh Teacher Eligibility Test (UPTET - Primary & Upper Primary)

exam_name: UPESSC Special TET (Primary & Upper Primary Special Education Teachers)

exam_name: Uttar Pradesh Post Graduate Teacher (UP PGT) Recruitment Examination

exam_name: Uttarakhand Teacher Eligibility Test (UTET - Paper I & Paper II)

exam_name: Uttarakhand Assistant Teacher (LT Grade) & Lecturer Direct Recruitment

exam_name: West Bengal Upper Primary Teacher Eligibility Test (WB Upper Primary TET / SLST)

exam_name: Chandigarh Junior Basic Training (JBT), TGT & PGT Direct Recruitment Examination
fact: Mandatory 80-Hour ICT Skill CCC Certification: Under Chandigarh Administration service conditions, all selected JBT, TGT, and PGT teachers must submit proof of completing a government-recognized 80-hour Course on Computer Concepts (CCC) prior to appointment.

exam_name: Jammu & Kashmir Teacher & Junior Assistant Direct Recruitment Examination
fact: UT Domicile Compulsion & District Cadre Quotas: All teaching posts advertised by JKSSB require an official Domicile Certificate of UT of J&K; candidates are selected under specific District and Divisional cadre rosters.

exam_name: Goa Directorate of Education Primary Teacher & Secondary Teacher Direct Recruitment
fact: 15-Year Continuous Residence & Konkani Knowledge: In Goa teaching recruitment, holding a 15-year continuous residence certificate issued by the Mamlatdar and demonstrative knowledge of Konkani language are non-negotiable statutory eligibility criteria.

exam_name: Puducherry Directorate of School Education Primary School Teacher & Lecturer Recruitment
fact: Region-Wise Quota (Puducherry, Karaikal, Mahe, Yanam): Posts are distributed across the four geographically separated enclaves of the Union Territory, with region-specific mother tongue requirements (Tamil for Puducherry/Karaikal, Malayalam for Mahe, Telugu for Yanam).

exam_name: Lakshadweep Directorate of Education Primary / Graduate Teacher Recruitment

exam_name: Ladakh School Education Department General Teacher Direct Recruitment
fact: District Cadre Autonomy under LAHDC: Teacher selections in Ladakh are governed through the Leh and Kargil Autonomous Hill Development Councils, with reservations restricted exclusively to permanent residents holding the UT Ladakh Resident Certificate.

exam_name: DNHDD Directorate of Education & Technical Education Lecturer / Teacher Direct Recruitment
fact: 85% Local Domicile Reservation: Faculty and lecturer recruitments across government polytechnics and colleges in Daman, Diu, and Dadra & Nagar Haveli implement an 85% domicile reservation for local certificate holders.

exam_name: Eklavya Model Residential Schools (EMRS) Teaching & Non-Teaching Staff Selection Exam

exam_name: State Bank of India Specialist Cadre Officers (SBI SCO) Direct Recruitment

exam_name: Bank of Baroda Specialist Officers & Wealth Management Professionals Recruitment

exam_name: Bank of India Specialist Officers (BOI SO) Direct Recruitment Project
fact: Scale II to Scale IV Lateral Entry: BOI SO covers mid-management and senior specialist profiles (Credit Officers, Risk Managers, Data Scientists, Security Officers) requiring 2 to 8 years mandatory post-qualification industry experience.

exam_name: Indian Overseas Bank Specialist Officers & Senior Manager Recruitment
fact: Credit, Information Security & Forex Specialization: IOB SO projects focus on hiring chartered accountants, MBA finance specialists, and B.Tech IT professionals directly into MMGS-II and MMGS-III officer cadres with probationary service of 1 year.

exam_name: Central Bank of India Counsellor (FLCC / RSETI) & Specialist Officer Recruitment

exam_name: Export-Import Bank of India Business Development Officer (Exim Bank BDO) Recruitment

exam_name: Export-Import Bank of India Deputy Manager & Manager (Scale I & II) Direct Recruitment
fact: Two-Tier Selection (Online Written Exam & Personal Interview): Exim Bank selects Deputy Managers through an all-India competitive online test administered via IBPS with descriptive English and financial management papers, followed by an interview in Mumbai.

exam_name: Small Industries Development Bank of India (SIDBI) Specialist Cadre Officers Recruitment

exam_name: Reserve Bank of India Bank Medical Consultant (RBI BMC - Regional Offices) Direct Recruitment

exam_name: Jammu & Kashmir Bank Zonal Security Officer & Specialist Cadre Direct Recruitment
